finding.deadline: 16 November 2026; five-year participation period for applicable securities
finding.summary: The uncertificated securities market regime takes effect on 16 November 2026. The SFC approved six securities registrars effective that date; listed issuers of prescribed securities must maintain an approved registrar, and existing prescribed securities constituted under Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Mainland China or Hong Kong law have five years to participate.
finding.title: SFC approves six securities registrars for upcoming uncertificated securities market regime
